name: io.github.igorsaevets/page2ai-mcp
title: Page2AI — Web to Markdown
description: Convert a web page URL to clean Markdown for LLM context. Local, no external API calls.

environmentVariables.name: PAGE2AI_BRIDGE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The key the Page2AI browser extension (1.6.0 or later) shows in its popup under Agent Bridge. With it, pages open in the user's own browser with its cookies; without it, the server fetches pages itself. Several keys: comma-separated.
